market_view: Calm regime (VIX 16, down 14% over 20 days) with yields stabilizing; gold at a three-month high, chips weak over five days on AI financing worries.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI rebounded 8% in five days, but that is a driver move already priced in. XOM headlines are a pipe contract (Corinth Pipeworks, Rovuma LNG) and a German regulator's carbon credit probe; neither is material.

gold_miners.reasoning: NEM is up 35% in 20 days. 'Why Is Newmont Stock Surging Friday?' (Yahoo) cites strong gold and a routine board appointment, not guidance. Gold at a three-month high is already priced in.

chips.reasoning: News is about Broadcom's $70B debt deal and credit-spread worries, not NVDA-specific. The NVDA earnings result is not in the record and there is no one-sided setup.

pharma.reasoning: LLY headlines are record-high and technical-setup commentary, which restates price. The sector rally came from Moderna and Merck news, not LLY, and LLY fell 2.8% yesterday.

copper_uranium.reasoning: 'Freeport-McMoRan Stock Hits All-Time High' (Benzinga) restates momentum. No FCX guidance, supply shock or copper-specific news. Copper itself is down 0.4% on the day.

would_change_my_mind: A leader-specific item: an XOM or NEM guidance change, an NVDA earnings result with a clear reaction setup, an FCX supply outage or guidance cut or raise, or an LLY approval or trial readout.

handoff.what_changed: Gold hit a three-month high and NEM rose further; FCX touched an all-time high; yields stabilized. Broadcom is raising $70B or more of debt for a chip financing deal, and the pharma sector rallied on Moderna and Merck news. No leader-specific catalyst appeared.

oil_gas.why: WTI rebound is priced in and XOM news is minor.

gold_miners.why: NEM is extended after 35% in 20 days and the news is only a board appointment.

chips.why: Broadcom debt and credit worries are not an NVDA-specific, one-sided catalyst.

pharma.why: No LLY trial, approval or pricing catalyst; commentary only.

copper_uranium.why: FCX all-time high is momentum, not a catalyst.
